theme: biogas digester fed from spoiling stockpiles
title: Biogas Digester Fed from Spoiling Stockpiles
strategies: trivial: feed each day's freshly-available stock in its own arrival ratio, scaled to capacity
greedy: each day, search the mix maximizing TODAY's achievable quality*volume (synergy- and inhibition-aware), oblivious to the adaptation state / switching cost
strong: full-horizon search over a single committed target trajectory (evaluated by replaying the whole schedule), plus a proactive salvage bump for batches about to expire
